descripcion: At A2 you give a very simple opinion with I think or I like and, if possible, a short reason with because. This basic skill is the foundation for more complex discussion at higher levels. Free debate and pre-empting counter-arguments come at higher levels.

ejemplos.texto: I think this restaurant is very good.
I don't like it, because it's expensive.

notas: I think is the simplest way to give an opinion.
Because can add a short reason.
I like is a useful alternative for preferences.

contraste.es: El español expresa opiniones con creo que o me gusta de forma muy similar, así que la estructura se transfiere fácilmente.

errores: Giving an opinion with no reason at all.
autochequeo: Have I given a reason if possible?
Have I used more than one phrase?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the opinion is clear and, if possible, has a reason with because. Do not rewrite the text. Check whether more than one phrase was used, not just the same one repeated.
